title: Convex geometry and the Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv problem
abstract: For every fixed positive dimension d, the Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv constant of (ZMod p)^d equals p times its hollow-family constant plus o(p) as p tends to infinity through primes. Includes the convex-flag Helly and centerpoint theorems, flag decomposition, balanced combinations, relative expansion, and the polynomial hollow-family bound.

informal.EGZ.theorem_1_2: For each positive dimension d, s((F_p)^d) = p w((F_p)^d) + o(p) as p tends to infinity through primes.
informal.EGZ.main_upper_bound: For each positive d and ε > 0, sufficiently large primes satisfy s((F_p)^d) ≤ (w((F_p)^d) + ε) p.
